appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.darkThemeHint: Used whenever the UI resolves to dark, including when “System” meets a dark OS.
appearance.darkThemeInactive: Currently on a light palette; this choice applies when dark.
appearance.themeLightDesc: Warm paper white, built for long reading sessions.
appearance.themeDarkDesc: Near-black neutral, quietest in low light.
appearance.themeMidnightDesc: Cool blue dark with clearer surface steps.
appearance.showBadgeHint: Shows how many scripts are active on the current page.
appearance.fontSizeHint: Scales the whole UI through rem, including controls, spacing and code.

about.title: About
about.privacyValue: All data stays on this device.

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.emptyDescription: Install a script from a URL, a file, or create one from scratch.
scripts.emptyTrashDescription: Deleted scripts will appear here so you can restore them.
scripts.confirmDelete: Move this script to the recycle bin?
scripts.confirmPurge: Permanently delete this script and its history?
scripts.confirmBatchDelete_one: Move {{count}} script to the recycle bin?
scripts.confirmBatchDelete_other: Move {{count}} scripts to the recycle bin?
scripts.purgeHint: Values and resources are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
scripts.trashHint: Deleted scripts keep their values and resources until permanently removed.

editor.title: Script editor
editor.name: Name
editor.overridesHint: Overrides are stored separately from the script source.
editor.unsavedHint: The code and the overrides you changed have not been saved to the script yet.
editor.author: Author
editor.capabilitiesHint: Declared by the script as @grant and @connect. Change them in the metadata block.
editor.valuesHint: Written by this script through GM_setValue, kept apart from the source.
editor.emptyValuesDescription: Values appear here once the script calls GM_setValue.
editor.addValueHint: The value is JSON: "text", 42, true, or an object.
editor.resourcesHint: Fetched from @require, @require-css and @resource. Change them in the metadata block.
editor.emptyResourcesDescription: Requires and resources appear here after the script is saved.
editor.matchHint: @match, one pattern per line: scheme://host/path, e.g. *://*.example.com/*.
editor.includeHint: @include, one glob or regular expression per line. Added on top of @match.
editor.excludeHint: @exclude — pages matching any line here are skipped.
editor.excludeMatchHint: @exclude-match, one match pattern per line. Removes pages matched elsewhere.
editor.runAtHint: When to inject: document-start, document-body, document-end, document-idle, context-menu, early-start.
editor.injectIntoHint: Which world the script runs in: auto, page, content.
editor.unwrapHint: @unwrap — hand the script the raw GM object without the compatibility wrapper.
editor.topLevelAwaitHint: @top-level-await — compile the script body as an async function.
editor.updateUrlHint: @updateurl — where update checks read the script metadata from.
editor.downloadUrlHint: @downloadurl — where the updated source is downloaded from.
editor.storageNameHint: @storagename — scripts sharing a name also share GM values.
editor.grantHint: @grant — the GM APIs this script is allowed to call.
editor.connectHint: @connect — hosts this script may reach through GM_xmlhttpRequest.
editor.infoAfterSave: Save the script once to see its metadata and runtime targets.

settings.title: Settings
settings.scriptsEnabledHint: Turn off to pause every userscript without uninstalling anything.
settings.forceSandbox: Force sandbox for scripts with grants
settings.forceSandboxHint: Runs grant scripts in the USER_SCRIPT world. Scripts that declare @grant unsafeWindow still run in the page world so unsafeWindow is the real page object.
settings.autoUpdateHint: Updates that add permissions are staged for confirmation instead of applied silently.
settings.logLevelHint: Entries below this level are dropped before they reach the log.
settings.defaultRunAtHint: Used when a script does not declare @run-at.
settings.defaultInjectIntoHint: Used when a script does not declare @inject-into.
settings.updateIntervalHint: How often to look for script updates in the background.
settings.runtimeHint: Live state of the userScripts registration table.

runtimeErrors.api-unavailable: The userScripts API is not available in this browser.
runtimeErrors.unexpected-result: The userScripts API returned an unexpected result.
runtimeErrors.disabled: User scripts are disabled. Enable “Allow User Scripts” on the browser’s extensions page.

settings.exportHint: Contains script source, metadata, values, resources, the recycle bin and settings. The runtime secret is never exported.
settings.exportZipHint: backup.json plus a readable .user.js file for every script.
settings.exportJsonHint: A single JSON file; smaller, but only restorable through this extension.
settings.importHint: Drop or choose a JSON or ZIP backup created by this extension.
settings.importDrop: Drop a JSON or ZIP backup
settings.importConflictHint: Matched by name and namespace against installed scripts.
settings.importSettingsHint: Appearance, language and execution preferences will be replaced by the backup.

backupErrors.invalidFormat: This file is not a Lumo Userscripts backup.
backupErrors.invalidShape: The backup file is incomplete or damaged.
backupErrors.zipMissingManifest: The ZIP does not contain backup.json.

settings.dataHint: Everything below stays on this device. Export files may contain sensitive script data, so store them accordingly.
